info.title: Sahaayi API
info.description: Sahaayi is an AI-powered elder-care companion. This API provides document intelligence, personal memory management, smart autofill, medication reminders, fall detection, medical transcription, and emergency response services.

post.description:
Register a new user account.
Returns the created user along with an initial JWT token pair.
Authenticate user credentials and return a fresh access and refresh token pair.
Exchange a valid refresh token for a new access token and rotated refresh token.

get.description: Retrieve profile details of the currently authenticated user.

post.description: Upload a document (Image or PDF) for personal memory indexing.

get.description: List all documents belonging to the authenticated user.
Retrieve verified personal profile memory bank.

patch.description: Add or update a verified personal memory field.

delete.description: Remove a field from personal memory.

post.description: Semantic matching of on-screen labels to verified profile data.
Audit and record user confirmation before injection.

get.description:
Liveness / readiness probe.

Returns a JSON object with:
- `status`: always "ok" if the service is running.
- `version`: the current API version.
- `environment`: the deployment environment.

200.description: Returns 200 when the service is healthy.
